# Handytoolkit

> Fast developer tools - JSON formatter, JWT decoder, Base64, UUID, hash. Privacy-first.

## About
Handytoolkit is a free, privacy-first online tool. No login, no tracking.

## Why
- 100% free
- Privacy-first
- Mobile responsive
- Multi-language EN/KO/JA
- Fast global CDN
- AI-friendly structured data
